Aspen Acres, Custer County. Transfer of command from CIMT (RM Team 3) back to the local unit will occur 
today. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with backing, creeping and 
smoldering. Numerous structures and communication infrastructure threatened. Area and road closures in 
effect. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 1). CIMT is also managing the 
Gold Mountain incident. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Minimal fire 
behavior with uphill runs, creeping and torching. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, 
brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with uphill runs, creeping and torching. Numerous structures and 
critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Rio Blanco, San Juan NF, USFS. Ten miles south of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Active 
fire behavior with short-range spotting and group torching. Numerous structures threatened. Area and road 
closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior with single tree torching, creeping and smoldering. Residences threatened. Area, road 
and trail closures in effect.
